verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes a standard US commercial fee schedule that agent-originated orders explicitly inherit (paypal-ac-supp-fees), so the underlying transaction pricing is public rather than secret. However, actually enabling the agentic channels (Agent Ready/Braintree, agentic commerce services, Store Sync) requires a gated onboarding form or contacting PayPal's AI team / Google directly (paypal-ac-supp-acs-gate, paypal-ac-supp-agent-ready), which reintroduces a sales-like conversation before a merchant can actually price and launch the channel. Missing for 10: a dedicated agentic/AI-channel fee page confirming no extra platform fee, and evidence that channel enablement itself is self-serve without contacting an AI/partner team.
